Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 5

“The state reached by the followers of Sankhya is also attained by the followers of Yoga. One who sees Sankhya and Yoga as one truly sees.”

The claim is about destination, not method. Krishna does not flatten the two practices; he insists they arrive at the same place, so choosing between them is not urgent.
